title: Blygger claim block
description: The JSON inside a fenced `claim` block in a blyg item's content_md. A `json` or unlabeled fence also counts when its object has both `probability` and `resolves_by`.

claim.description: The statement being forecast, in one sentence. Recommended.

probability.description: The author's probability that the claim resolves true.

resolves_by.description: The last day (ISO date, UTC) on which the claim can resolve.

criteria.description: How the outcome will be decided, specific enough for someone else to apply. Recommended.

provenance.description: Where the claim comes from: a URL or a short note.

discussion.description: Where the claim is being argued.

commit.description: Commit-reveal: sha256 of salt and the hidden claim, revealed in a later version.
